workouts.title: Week overview
workouts.description:
This week is our third week of the fitness phase. We will switch the daily focus to weightlifting on Day 1 & 3 with gymnastics on day 2. Now that we are into the rhythm of the phase you should start to see progressions and familiarity this week. Dig into those progressions and crush them!
Have fun!
